task: Standing trace for automated dependency/action pin bumps (e.g. Dependabot) under .github/workflows/**: what CI verifies so a routine version bump does not need a new hand-written trace per PR

events.summary: A qualifying bump changes only a workflow file's `uses:` pin (SHA and human-readable version comment); no job, permission, trigger, or script logic changes, and no manifest/lockfile (dependabot.yml here only watches github-actions)
Verified the target action reference was already expressed as an immutable 40-character commit SHA with a version comment before the bump, per the repo's mutable-input policy

Bump replaces only the pinned SHA (and its version comment) for the dependency identified by the automated PR; each removed `uses:` line pairs 1:1 with an added `uses:` line for the identical owner/repo(/path), the new ref is a 40-character commit SHA, and no other content line changes

check-mutable-inputs.py re-verifies every GitHub Action reference in protected workflows is still a 40-character commit SHA after the bump; check-agent-trace-requirement.py additionally verifies the diff has no CR/NEL/line-separator smuggling, no binary/rename/mode-change markers, strictly paired `uses:` lines, and that every PR commit's GitHub-verified author and committer login is the trusted bot
events.scope: GitHub Action pin immutability and commit provenance across .github/workflows

events.summary: Agent Behavior workflow's behavior-contract job (including the dependency-bump exemption in check-agent-trace-requirement.py) and Lint & Validate run unmodified against the bump
Pin-only dependency bumps from a trusted automated author are covered by this standing trace via risk-policy.json's dependencyBumpExemption; any other change still requires its own trace
Complete and verified; this trace is reused across qualifying dependency-bump PRs rather than regenerated per PR
